use_case: Demand forecasting by product family for capacity planning, material purchasing, and storm-restoration slot proposals
vendor_or_model: Company-built time-series model on the cloud tenant managed ML service
data_categories: ERP order history by customer segment; backlog; public hurricane-season outlooks; includes FCI (federal delivery schedule); no personal data
consequential_decision_category: None (business planning; affects utility customers' production slots, not individuals)
human_in_the_loop: Production Planning Manager approves every monthly plan; minimum storm-slot allocation rule overrides the forecast
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21 (FCI stays in the company tenant); no sector or state AI rule applies; CSF 2.0 benchmark (P03 G-012)

use_case: Predictive maintenance alerts for drying ovens and 4 coil winding machines from historian data
vendor_or_model: Predictive maintenance vendor SaaS (vendor model trained on company and fleet data)
data_categories: About 140 historian process tags (temperatures, pressures, currents, vibration); operator ID tags excluded; no personal data
consequential_decision_category: None today; escalates to Safety/CI if used to extend or skip preventive maintenance on ovens, vacuum, or oil fill
human_in_the_loop: Maintenance Manager decides every action; preventive maintenance schedule unchanged; read-only connector
applicable_laws: No sector or state AI rule applies; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims); SP 800-82 Rev. 3 benchmark for the new OT connection (P03 G-030, G-046)
status: Pilot (since 2026-04); continue with conditions, no expansion

use_case: Public generative AI chatbots used by engineers and office staff for drafting and calculations
data_categories: Risk of Restricted design data and FCI being pasted
risk_tier: Low for Internal and Public data in an approved enterprise tool; prohibited for Restricted data and FCI
human_in_the_loop: Qualified person reviews any output used in a design, quote, or customer document
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21(b)(1)(iii) (no FCI in public tools; P03 G-066); customer NDAs
status: Prohibited for Restricted data and FCI (POL-05 4.8); enterprise tool under evaluation; web filtering by 2026-10-31
